summary: The Blazing Citadel is the fortified heart of the Fire Plane’s military might. Flame‑forged halls, ember‑lit battlements, and molten throne chambers form the seat of the Ember King’s dominion.
history: Forged from divine flame during the first elemental war.
Expanded by Pyre Knights and Blazeforge artisans over millennia.
Citadel battlements were built to withstand firestorms and molten eruptions.
The Ember King claimed the citadel as his throne after defeating rival flame lords.
